name: Default
shortDescription: Model-swapping proxy that runs local GGUF models on demand with llama.cpp on CPU, with an OpenAI compatible API and a web UI protected by an API key.

alerts.message: The web UI and API are protected by the generated LLAMA_SWAP_API_KEY. In the browser login prompt enter any username and the key as password; API clients send it as a Bearer token.
Models are downloaded from Hugging Face on their first request, so the first answer from each model takes a while. Add or change models in config.yaml; larger models need more RAM.
